4694-5805-6797-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5805-6797-7306.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

2178-4247-5470.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
2178-4247-5470.description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

907-5147-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

1263-3967-4556-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-1322-1902.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1322-1902.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1169-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1169-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1169-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2034-4871-7147-7654-7729.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {1}{U}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Repeat.

2060-4893-5140-7704.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-4893-5140-7704.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1367-4499-7417.description:
If Nexus of Fate is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Blink Sanar using Emiel the Blessed. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
1367-4499-7417.notes: If Nexus of Fate is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

3528-3976-7435.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3528-3976-7435.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Rise of the Eldrazi.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{R}{B}, noting Rise of the Eldrazi and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the 3/3 creature that has Rise of the Eldrazi noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Rise of the Eldrazi without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Rise of the Eldrazi copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.
Cast Rise of the Eldrazi by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Rise of the Eldrazi and putting it face down as a 3/3 creature.
Move to your next turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the face down creature.
The face down creature triggers, causing you to cast a copy of Rise of the Eldrazi without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Rise of the Eldrazi, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3.
3528-3976-7435.notes: The discard outlet is provided as a method of getting Rise of the Eldrazi into your graveyard, as it does not go to the graveyard after resolution. You can substitute any other method for this, including using mill or other techniques.

147-2292-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2292-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2292-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5359-7292.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5359-7292.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-5231-7218.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Reaping Willow.
When Reaping Willow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2981-6972-7155.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

4002-4030-4331-4993.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4030-4331-4993.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

222-527-5231-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-1746-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3967-4375-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

2558-4186-4779-6701.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.
2558-4186-4779-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

971-1268-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had five nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
971-1268-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five charge counters on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism five times by removing five charge counters from it, adding {4}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.

856-2292-4321-6462.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2292-4321-6462.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Kheru Goldkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1636-2034-6095.notablePrerequisites:
You have a Zombie creature card in your graveyard.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the Zombie in your graveyard minus at most {C}{C}.
Zul Ashur does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2034-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting a Zombie card in your graveyard.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding enough mana to cast the Zombie.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

784-1750-2793-2921-5261.notablePrerequisites: Silas Renn cannot be blocked by an opponent.
784-1750-2793-2921-5261.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Silas Renn, triggering Silas Renn, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2136-2816-4242-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Orthion.
2136-2816-4242-5231.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Su-Chi with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Su-Chi tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}.
When the Su-Chi tokens die, they trigger, adding twelve {C}.
Activate Orthion by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other creature you control.

662-1543-3666-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Nissa has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
662-1543-3666-4312.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Nissa to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Nissa.
Activate Nissa by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

942-2034-3652-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {C}{C}.
When Ornithopter dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted, adding {C}{C}.
When Samwise the Stouthearted dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Samwise the Stouthearted from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Samwise the Stouthearted enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand, and causing the Ring to tempt you.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

824-3334-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has a counter on it.
824-3334-4289.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a counter from a creature, and putting two of that type of counter on another target creature you control.
Repeat.

1309-2564-4231-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lonis.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

3750-4076-4772.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three creatures in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
3750-4076-4772.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Burakos triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose at least three life.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1414-2173-4195-4574.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lotus Petal from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

92-346-3591.notablePrerequisites: Greater lifetotal than the highest life among opponents.
92-346-3591.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability.
Activate Necropotence until you are at 1 life.
Sacrifice Tainted Sigil.
You gain life equal to the amount of life lost by all players this turn, and each opponent loses that much life.

2525-4283-4314-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2525-4283-4314-5295.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing itself and any other creature you control, targeting Body Double.
Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating at least one 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Whisper ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Whisper.
Activate Body Double by tapping it, sacrificing itself and the Eldrazi Spawn token, targeting Whisper.
Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Whisper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
